items.title: How Could Devon Energy (DVN) Reshape Its Future With A $4.2 Billion Deal?
items.summary: Devon Energy (NYSE:DVN) agreed to sell its Eagle Ford assets to Crescent Energy in a US$4.2b cash transaction. The divested Eagle Ford position represents about 4% of Devon Energy's total production footprint. Management plans to direct sale proceeds toward share repurchases and debt reduction, in line with its portfolio focus on longer-duration assets. items.title: 6 Big Funds Bought Devon Energy. Is It a Buy Before Earnings?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSix funds managing $2 billion to $6 billion each in US stocks reported new stakes in Devon Energy (DVN:NYSE) in their 13Fs for the quarter ended June 30, and the stock is up 15% since. Analysts’ average target sits 27% above Devon’s price, while ConocoPhillips (COP:NYSE), EOG Resources (EOG:NYSE) and Canadian Natural Resources (CNQ) all trade near or above their own targets.
